assumptions: Source locations, route objective nodes, utilities and trial effort are explicit manual assumptions; no source location is inferred
Each opportunity is an independent alternative, not a combined acquisition schedule; unknown reward coverage blocks additional credit
Incremental travel replaces one guarded route leg and includes rejoin/return; baseline travel and stopping are reserved once
Graph routes preserve estimated/unknown edges and do not establish walkable road geometry; no shared-kill savings or useful lifespan is inferred
Utilities, objective node associations and completion/service times are explicit manual inputs
Expected-time greedy baseline; estimates are not guaranteed durations
No speculative prerequisite unlocks or party fairness; declared quest predicates only
Weights, class, categories, proficiency, durations, spending ceilings and trial semantics are explicit manual assumptions; no game tables are supplied
Model scores are not measured damage or survivability; useful lifespan is unknown
Obtainable includes only individually guaranteed acquisitions; probabilistic candidates remain separately inspectable
Practical estimates evaluate one acquisition against a complete legal baseline; independent upgrade probabilities are never combined
gear-practical-v1 floors conditional success probability to millionths and expected positive gain to score thousandths; ordering uses exact bounded cross-products
Zero reserved effort with positive expected gain sorts first; reserved effort covers maximum feasible trials, not expected time-to-success
